tools.name: run_vacuum_analyze_job
tools.description: Runs VACUUM ANALYZE on a given table in the Postgres database to reclaim space and refresh planner statistics. Executes the maintenance command and returns its output.

params.name: table
params.description: Table name to vacuum, optionally schema-qualified

params.name: full
params.description: Use VACUUM FULL instead of a plain vacuum

tools.code:
import os
import re
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

_PAT = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)?$')


@tool
def run_vacuum_analyze_job(table: str, full: bool = False) -> str:
    if not _PAT.match(table):
        return 'error: invalid table name'
    dsn = os.environ.get('DATABASE_URL', 'postgresql://localhost/postgres')
    opt = 'FULL, ANALYZE' if full else 'ANALYZE'
    q = f'VACUUM ({opt}) {table};'
    p = subprocess.run(
        ['psql', dsn, '-v', 'ON_ERROR_STOP=1', '-c', q],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=3600,
    )
    o = p.stdout.strip()
    e = p.stderr.strip()
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return f'failed ({p.returncode}): {e}'
    return o or 'vacuum complete'

tools.name: revoke_database_role_membership
tools.description: Removes a user from a membership role in the Postgres database, so the user loses the permissions that role provided.

params.name: member
params.description: Role to remove from the group

params.name: group_role
params.description: Group role to revoke membership in

tools.code:
import os
import psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql


def revoke_database_role_membership(member: str, group_role: str) -> str:
    conn = psycopg2.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
    with conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            sql.SQL('REVOKE {} FROM {}').format(
                sql.Identifier(group_role),
                sql.Identifier(member),
            )
        )
    conn.close()
    return f'revoked {group_role} from {member}'

tools.name: explain_analyze_query
tools.description: Runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a SELECT query against the database, which actually executes the query, and returns the plan with timing details.
tools.code:
import os
import psycopg2
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP('dba-tools')


@mcp.tool()
def explain_analyze_query(query: str) -> dict:
    result = {'query': query, 'plan': [], 'error': None}
    if not query.strip().lower().startswith('select'):
        result['error'] = 'only SELECT statements are allowed'
        return result
    conn = psycopg2.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
    conn.set_session(readonly=True)
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute('EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) ' + query)
        result['plan'] = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
    conn.close()
    result['lines'] = len(result['plan'])
    return result
